### acme/aidenhq fix/engineer-gh-cve (9d2c1f4a7b3e)
diff --git a/services/computer/images/engineer/Dockerfile b/services/computer/images/engineer/Dockerfile
index 4f1e2a9..b7c3d81 100644
--- a/services/computer/images/engineer/Dockerfile
+++ b/services/computer/images/engineer/Dockerfile
@@ -4,6 +4,13 @@ ARG BASE=aidenhq/computer-agent-base
 FROM ${BASE}
 RUN apt-get update && apt-get install -y --no-install-recommends \
-      build-essential pkg-config libssl-dev python3-pip python3-dev golang-go make gh \
+      build-essential pkg-config libssl-dev python3-pip python3-dev golang-go make gnupg \
     && rm -rf /var/lib/apt/lists/*
+# gh 2.104.0 fixes CVE-2026-48501; Debian sid still carries 2.46.0-4, so it comes from GitHub's own apt repository. The
+# key's full fingerprint is checked before the repository is trusted, and the package is pinned. One package, one source,
+# this image only.
+RUN curl -fsSL https://cli.github.com/packages/githubcli-archive-keyring.gpg -o /usr/share/keyrings/githubcli-archive-keyring.gpg \
+    && gpg --show-keys --with-colons /usr/share/keyrings/githubcli-archive-keyring.gpg | awk -F: '$1 == "fpr" { print $10 }' | grep -qx 2C6106201985B60E6C7AC87323F3D4EA75716059 \
+    && echo "deb [signed-by=/usr/share/keyrings/githubcli-archive-keyring.gpg] https://cli.github.com/packages stable main" >/etc/apt/sources.list.d/github-cli.list \
+    && apt-get update && apt-get install -y --no-install-recommends gh=2.104.0 && rm -rf /var/lib/apt/lists/*

files.text:
# An engineer's computer: the base plus toolchains. gh is installed without a token: pushes and merges are the runner's, against an
# approval. BASE is the agent-base tag (ops/computer-images.sh).
ARG BASE=aidenhq/computer-agent-base
FROM ${BASE}
RUN apt-get update && apt-get install -y --no-install-recommends \
      build-essential pkg-config libssl-dev python3-pip python3-dev golang-go make gnupg \
    && rm -rf /var/lib/apt/lists/*
# gh 2.104.0 fixes CVE-2026-48501; Debian sid still carries 2.46.0-4, so it comes from GitHub's own apt repository. The
# key's full fingerprint is checked before the repository is trusted, and the package is pinned. One package, one source,
# this image only.
RUN curl -fsSL https://cli.github.com/packages/githubcli-archive-keyring.gpg -o /usr/share/keyrings/githubcli-archive-keyring.gpg \
    && gpg --show-keys --with-colons /usr/share/keyrings/githubcli-archive-keyring.gpg | awk -F: '$1 == "fpr" { print $10 }' | grep -qx 2C6106201985B60E6C7AC87323F3D4EA75716059 \
    && echo "deb [signed-by=/usr/share/keyrings/githubcli-archive-keyring.gpg] https://cli.github.com/packages stable main" >/etc/apt/sources.list.d/github-cli.list \
    && apt-get update && apt-get install -y --no-install-recommends gh=2.104.0 && rm -rf /var/lib/apt/lists/*
